scope: Post hoc within-patient diagnostic motivated by the six frozen case illustrations; not an independent confirmation endpoint
cohort: All prior fresh20 patients, no selection or exclusions based on phase results
models: Existing frozen continuation 40k best development checkpoints
intervention: Identical Gaussian blur, factor-3 sampling distance and common 3-mm model grid; change only the native-z sampling origin by 1 or 2 original slices. Affine origin follows the selected phase. Extend the first and final retained planes to cover the acquired field of view.
control: Regenerate phase 0 using the original implementation and require exact float16 input-array agreement. Original phase-0 native predictions reused unchanged.
metrics: Original-grid Dice/HD95 for all four organs, all phases and seeds; extra Dice restricted to the common interior excluding 9 mm from both scan ends as a boundary sensitivity check
analyses: All phase-minus-zero paired effects, context-by-augmentation per phase, per-patient and per-organ phase range. Three seeds averaged within patient; 10000 patient bootstrap, seed 2026111505. All analyses exploratory and unadjusted.
interpretation: A controlled acquisition-sampling alignment sensitivity test; phase-dependent error is not a causal explanation for every original patient difference. End extension changes near the scan boundaries and is audited separately.
